newsitem.title: USA: Owosso sees Q1 pretax loss of $100,000.
newsitem.headline: Owosso sees Q1 pretax loss of $100,000.

text.p: Owosso Corp said Monday it expects to report a pretax loss of about $100,000 for its first fiscal quarter ended January 26, 1997.
The company said the loss "represents a significant improvement" over the results reported in the fourth quarter of its fiscal year 1996.
The company said it also expects to report sales of about $30.2 million for the first quarter, an increase of about 8.0 percent over the comparable quarter in 1996, it said.

George Lemmon, president and chief executive officer, said, "While we obvviously would have preffered to report a profit in our seasonally slow fist quarter, we remain encouraged about our prospects for the full year."

He said bookings and backlogs are both over 20 percent compared to the same period last year and most of the company's businesses are running ahead of last year, expecially its motor and agricultural equipment businesses.
Lemmon said the company expects to show a small operating loss for its Sooner Trailer operation for the first quarter but believes the unit will improve toward the end of the quarter.

"Sooner should be profitable beginning in the second quarter, helped by the improving manufacturing performance as well as a selected price increase that went into effect at the beginning of February, it said.
The company said it expects to report its firsacal first quarter results on March 6.
